claims.text: Under Spec 037, an exact-string match of a portion catalogue number against a corpus_master object id is a candidate for a same-object join.

evidence.description: corpus_master on main: 2,722 rows from two sources (mayig CISI digitisation 179; Yajnadevam corpus 2,543) - the mixed provenance the intake's 693 matches were counted against

alternatives: Catalogue numbers are unique object identifiers across compilations, so a string match is a join.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 037 product that counts, joins, or cites a string match as a same-object join without ladder grading defeats this claim.

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C02 disciplines the candidates (what a match is); C03 disciplines the promotion (how a candidate verifies). Neither states the other's content: C02 would stand even if the ladder were different, and the ladder presupposes C02 without restating it.

metadata.verdict_rule: Untreated string matches are reported as candidates in every Spec 037 product.

alternatives: Joins may be verified case by case on analyst judgement, or by the string match plus one agreeing field.
falsification_tests: Any join recorded as VERIFIED that did not pass every applicable ladder step, or any candidate graded under a different rule, defeats this claim.

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C03 fixes how a join verifies; C11 fixes what is reported about the grading. A product could satisfy one and breach the other (verify correctly, report selectively), so both are needed; neither restates the other.
metadata.strongest_rival: Joins may be verified case by case on analyst judgement, or by the string match plus one agreeing field.
metadata.verdict_rule: VERIFIED is a ladder outcome, produced by the fixed rule over the full census, or it is not used.

metadata.verdict_rule: Conflicts appear in the record with reason codes, at their full counted rate, or this claim fails.

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C05 is the only claim that can stop the build; C03/C04 define the grades it counts. The halt is an aggregate property (a share over the census), which no per-candidate claim can express, so it is stated separately.
metadata.strongest_rival: The spine may be built from whatever verified joins exist, at any conflict rate, since each join passed the ladder individually.
metadata.verdict_rule: Above the threshold there is no spine; below it the spine contains VERIFIED joins only.
